title: “If your prayer life never produces an apology… it might just be a podcast 🎙️😅.”
paragraphs:
“If your prayer life never produces an apology… it might just be a podcast 🎙️😅.”
Sometimes the holiest thing you can say is “My bad.” 🙏💭
—Because real conversation with God changes you too. 💡

“If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.”
— 1 John 1:9 ✨
